description: 注記のない形に注記を書くと { key: 値, note: 注記 } にする（field: "note"）

files.profiles/default/position_map.yaml:
left_hand:
  row0: [tab, Q, W, E, R, T]
  row1: [caps, A, S, D, F, G]
  row2: [lshift, Z, X, C, V, B]
  row3: [lctrl, command, option]
  thumb_keys: [left, middle, right]
right_hand:
  row0: [Y, U, I, O, P, backspace]
  row1: [H, J, K, L, colon, enter]
  row2: [N, M, comma, dot, up, rshift]
  row3: [left, down, right]
  thumb_keys: [left, middle, right]
encoders:
  left: { push: push, ccw: ccw, cw: cw }
  right: { push: push, ccw: ccw, cw: cw }
files.profiles/default/layers/0_base.yaml:
name: Base
index: 0
mapping:
  left_hand:
    row0:
      tab: Tab
      Q: { key: Q, note: 注記 }
    row1: { caps: LCtrl }
    row2:
    row3:
    thumb_keys:
  right_hand:
    row0:
    row1: { K: K, L: L }
    row2:
    row3:
    thumb_keys:
files.profiles/default/macros/00_pair.yaml:
name: Pair
index: 0
sequence:
- action: tap
  keys:
  - KC_LBRACKET
  - KC_RBRACKET
# Shift を押したまま
- action: down
  keys: KC_LSHIFT # 押す
files.profiles/default/tap_dance/00_tab_escape:
name: Tab Escape
index: 0
actions:
  on_tap: KC_TAB
  on_hold: KC_ESCAPE
tapping_term: 200
files.profiles/default/combos/00_bracket.yaml:
name: Bracket
index: 0
trigger_keys: [KC_K, KC_L]
output_key: Macro('Pair')
